title: Structure Pack Trio #40 (맥시 굵은 스트라이프·물결 / 맥시 큰 조각 4개·물결 / 임산부 비대칭 몬드리안·매끈 | UV네온+코이비늘 / 스테인드글라스+목재+이레즈미+뱀비늘 / 목재+흑요암금+나비날개비늘+이레즈미)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, latina curves physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — her body carries 2 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 thick diagonal stripes by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 28% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top and about 78% of the way down her figure from the top. The stripes alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but nebula birth cluster formations in ELECTRIC MAGENTA and GOLD glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Region 2 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme latina curves silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

Region 2 is the piece above the long diagonal and beyond the second branch (the upper right): it carries pale golden oak wood fused directly into her own form, natural straight grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING warm honey-blonde grain with VIVID amber highlight streaks. Region 3 is the piece below the long diagonal and before the third branch (the lower left): it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, wisteria formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET and STARK WHITE, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 4 is the piece below the long diagonal and beyond the third branch (the lower right): it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

#3: German, in her early 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and dominating her entire middle, an enormous taut, high, rounded pregnant belly, far larger and more prominent than any ordinary pregnancy, projecting forward dramatically, the navel pushed outward on its smooth rounded surface. Enormous round hips below it, gigantic soft thighs, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, 15 segment rings piercings set with pearls in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of platinum earrings. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 33% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 56% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 26% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition, realistic photographic grain on the realistic-skin and pregnant women, extreme high-gloss oil on the darkest-skin women. CRITICAL: all 3 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. THREE completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 4:5 aspect ratio.
